cards.example_en: Reading every day can improve your English.
cards.example_zh: 每天阅读可以提高你的英语水平。

cards.example_en: The books are in my school bag.
cards.example_zh: 书在我的书包里。

cards.example_en: The ticket price will include lunch and the bus fare.
cards.example_zh: 票价里将包括午餐和车费。

cards.example_en: Warm weather will increase the sales of cold drinks.
cards.example_zh: 天气变暖后，冷饮的销量会增加。

cards.example_en: Shipbuilding is still a major industry along this coast.
cards.example_zh: 造船仍然是这片海岸的重要工业。

cards.example_en: My teacher had a big influence on me.
cards.example_zh: 我的老师对我有很大的影响。

cards.example_en: This leaflet gives information about bus routes to the museum.
cards.example_zh: 这张传单提供了去博物馆的公交路线信息。

cards.example_en: The insect rested on a green leaf.
cards.example_zh: 那只昆虫停在绿叶上。

cards.example_en: The keys are inside my coat pocket by the door.
cards.example_zh: 钥匙就在门边我外套的口袋里面。

cards.example_en: Let's walk instead of taking the bus.
cards.example_zh: 让我们步行而不是乘坐公交车。

cards.example_en: Follow the instruction on the packet before you bake.
cards.example_zh: 烘烤前先按照包装上的说明去做。

cards.example_en: She carried her instrument onto the stage in a soft case.
cards.example_zh: 她把乐器放在软盒里拿上了舞台。

cards.example_en: His interest in birds started after a trip to the wetlands.
cards.example_zh: 一次湿地之行之后，他对鸟类产生了兴趣。

cards.example_en: The documentary about whales was interesting for our class.
cards.example_zh: 那部关于鲸鱼的纪录片我们班觉得很有趣。

cards.example_en: An international student joined our class this term.
cards.example_zh: 这学期有一位国际学生加入了我们班。

cards.example_en: She checked the Internet for the museum's opening hours.
cards.example_zh: 她在互联网上查了博物馆的开放时间。

cards.example_en: Job interview nerves made her voice shake at first.
cards.example_zh: 求职面试让她紧张，声音一开始都在发抖。

cards.example_en: She walked into the classroom quietly.
cards.example_zh: 她安静地走进了教室。

cards.example_en: Let me introduce my cousin from Shanghai to you.
cards.example_zh: 让我把从上海来的表姐介绍给你。

cards.example_en: Who invented the telephone?
cards.example_zh: 谁发明了电话？

cards.example_en: We invite our neighbours to the New Year dinner.
cards.example_zh: 我们邀请邻居们来家里吃年夜饭。

cards.example_en: They spent a week on a small island.
cards.example_zh: 他们在一个小岛上度过了一个星期。

cards.example_en: It is raining outside right now.
cards.example_zh: 外面现在正在下雨。

cards.example_en: The dog wagged its tail happily.
cards.example_zh: 狗高兴地摇着尾巴。

cards.example_en: The door closed by itself.
cards.example_zh: 门自己关上了。

cards.example_en: Mud splashed my jacket when the bus passed a puddle.
cards.example_zh: 公交车经过水坑时，泥点溅到了我的夹克上。

cards.example_en: Muddy jeans dried on the line behind the house.
cards.example_zh: 沾了泥的牛仔裤在屋后的绳子上晾干了。

cards.example_en: A weekend job at the bookshop helps her save for college.
cards.example_zh: 她周末在书店打工，好攒上大学的钱。

cards.example_en: They jog around the playground every morning.
cards.example_zh: 他们每天早上绕操场慢跑。

cards.example_en: Join the art club if you enjoy painting.
cards.example_zh: 如果你喜欢画画，就加入美术社团吧。

cards.example_en: That joke about the lost cat made even the driver laugh.
cards.example_zh: 那个关于走失的猫的笑话连司机都逗笑了。

cards.example_en: Our journey over the mountains took two full days.
cards.example_zh: 我们翻山的旅程花了整整两天。

cards.example_en: Pure joy showed on his face when the puppy arrived.
cards.example_zh: 小狗到的时候，他脸上满是喜悦。

cards.example_en: Three teachers will judge the English speech contest.
cards.example_zh: 三位老师将评判英语演讲比赛。

cards.example_en: Apple juice stained the white cloth on the picnic table.
cards.example_zh: 苹果汁弄脏了野餐桌上的白桌布。

cards.example_en: The cat can jump from the chair onto the table.
cards.example_zh: 猫可以从椅子跳到桌子上。

cards.example_en: She is a junior high student.
cards.example_zh: 她是一名初中生。

cards.example_en: I just finished my homework.
cards.example_zh: 我刚做完作业。

cards.example_en: Please keep the classroom clean.
cards.example_zh: 请保持教室干净。

cards.example_en: Timing is a key skill in the relay race.
cards.example_zh: 在接力赛里，把握时机是一项关键技能。

cards.example_en: Please clean the computer keyboard.
cards.example_zh: 请把电脑键盘擦干净。

cards.example_en: Kick the football toward the goal rather than the seats.
cards.example_zh: 把足球踢向球门，别踢向座位。

cards.example_en: The kid across the hall lent me a spare pencil.
cards.example_zh: 走廊对面的小孩借给我一支备用铅笔。

cards.example_en: Late frost can kill young plants in the garden.
cards.example_zh: 晚霜会把花园里的幼苗冻死。

cards.example_en: Please buy one kilo of apples.
cards.example_zh: 请买一公斤苹果。

cards.example_en: The park is one kilometre from here.
cards.example_zh: 公园离这里一公里。

cards.example_en: It was very kind of you to help me.
cards.example_zh: 你能帮助我，真是太好了。

cards.example_en: In the play, the king loses his crown in the forest.
cards.example_zh: 在这出戏里，国王把王冠丢在了森林里。

cards.example_en: She blew a kiss to her little sister.
cards.example_zh: 她给妹妹送了一个飞吻。

cards.example_en: Mum is washing vegetables in the kitchen before dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭前，妈妈正在厨房里洗蔬菜。

word.example_en: Please call when you arrive at a place.
word.example_zh: 你到达某地时请打电话。
word.ipa: /əˈraɪv æt ə pleɪs/ / /əˈraɪv ɪn ə pleɪs/

word.example_en: Let us walk instead of taking a taxi.
word.example_zh: 我们走路吧，而不是打车。

word.example_en: She began to take an interest in robots.
word.example_zh: 她开始对机器人产生兴趣。

word.example_en: I looked up the word on the Internet.
Come and join in the game.
I saw him in the hall just now.
word.example_zh: 我刚才在大厅看见他了。

word.example_en: Keep on trying, and you will improve.

word.example_zh: 继续保持这样好的表现。

word.example_en: The rain can keep us from playing outside.
word.example_zh: 雨会阻止我们在外面玩。

word.example_en: A panda is a kind of animal.
